text.从一句「你好」出发，把 Tcl 变成你的超能力。: Start with a hello and make Tcl your new superpower.

text.准备好了。改一行代码，然后点「运行代码」。: Ready. Change a line, then choose Run code.

text.全部检查通过！这一关的 XP 已经领取过了。: All checks passed! You already earned this lesson’s XP.
text.还差一点。对照目标输出和提示，再试一次。: Almost there. Compare the target output and hints, then try again.
text.检查变量是否先用 set 定义，名字是否拼写一致。: Check that the variable was defined with set and its name is spelled consistently.
text.检查命令拼写和大小写。EDA 工具扩展命令不一定能在普通 Tcl 中运行。: Check the command’s spelling and case. EDA extension commands may not exist in ordinary Tcl.
text.花括号没有配对：检查每一个 { 是否都有对应的 }。: A brace is unmatched: check that every { has a matching }.
text.方括号没有配对：检查 [ 和 ]。: A bracket is unmatched: check the [ and ] pairs.
text.参数数量不对。检查空格、引号和命令的参数顺序。: The argument count is wrong. Check spaces, quotes and argument order.
text.从错误信息里的命令和行号开始检查，或者打开提示，和示例逐行比较。: Start with the command and line in the error message, or compare the example and hints.
text.一行代码，一小步进步。: One line of code. One small step forward.
text.四段原创代码演示，配中文画面字幕。随时暂停，回到实验室照着试。: Four original demos with English on-screen explanations. Pause anytime and try the code in the lab.
text.视频没有配音；每段都有文字稿，读文字也能完整学习。: These silent demos each include a complete text transcript.
text.浏览器不支持视频，请阅读下方文字稿。: Your browser cannot play this video. Read the transcript below.
text.第一行代码与变量: First lines of code and variables
text.不用赶路。这里没有倒计时。: Take your time. There is no countdown.
text.你只需要会使用浏览器。可以自己探索，也可以和朋友、家长或老师一起学。建议每次学一: You only need a browser. Explore alone or with friends, family or a teacher. Try one or two lessons per session, about 10–30 minutes.
text.每关怎么玩？: How do I play a lesson?
text.读故事和图解，认识一个新概念。: Read the story and illustrations to meet a new idea.
text.运行小例子，猜猜修改一行会发生什么。: Run an example and predict what changing a line will do.
text.点击「恢复起始代码」，完成任务。: Choose Reset starter and complete the mission.
text.点「提交挑战」，通过检查就获得 XP。: Choose Check mission. Passing the checks earns XP.
text.答一道理解题，试做一个拓展练习。: Answer a concept question and try the extension task.
text.答错不会扣分。所有关卡都能自由进入，XP 只在首次通关时领取。: Wrong answers cost no points. All lessons are open, and XP is earned once per lesson.
text.按自己的经验选择路线: Choose a route for your experience
text.从第 1 关起，先照着例子试，再改一处。不认识的英文把它当作工具名字。: Start at lesson 1, copy a small example and change one thing. Treat unfamiliar command names as names of tools.
text.先看第 3 关的括号规则，再挑战各区域 Boss。: Review lesson 3’s quoting rules, then try each world’s Boss.
text.完成基础后进入第 16–20 关。这里的 EDA 操作是教学模拟，商业软件命令请: Finish the basics, then explore lessons 16–20. EDA operations here are teaching models; use your course tool documentation for commercial commands.
text.首次运行下载约 4.4 MB 的本地资源。Tcl 在浏览器 Worker 中执行: The first run loads about 4.4 MB of local resources. Tcl runs in a browser Worker with a fresh environment and a five-second timeout. Files live in memory.
text.草稿、XP 和徽章保存在当前浏览器，不跨设备同步。使用下面的导出、导入功能转移进: Drafts, XP and badges are stored in this browser. Export and import progress to move it between devices. Import replaces your current progress.
text.这是自学记录，不是防作弊成绩系统。: This is a self-study record rather than a secured grading system.
text.想在电脑或云端继续？: Continue locally or in the cloud?
text.仓库提供 Dev Container，可通过 GitHub Codespaces: The repository includes a Dev Container for GitHub Codespaces. GitHub plan limits or charges may apply; the browser lab needs no account.

text.我负责陪你观察、尝试和排错。程序里出现的 Ada、Bo 等名字是可以更换的数据，: I help you observe, experiment and debug. Names such as Ada and Bo in the code are changeable data, not fixed answers.
text.我会把代码变成能看见的东西。先看一遍，再换个输入试试；学得慢也没关系。: I turn code into things you can see. Watch once, then try a different input. Take all the time you need.
text.和我一起比较条件、整理清单、逐个采集。留意“刚好等于”和“一个也没有”的情况。: Join me to compare conditions, organize lists and collect items. Watch for boundary values and empty input.
text.好工具应当能重复使用。我会陪你检查新输入、小数、空列表和可能出错的地方。: A good tool is reusable. Let us check new inputs, decimals, empty lists and possible errors.
text.把已经学会的 Tcl 带进芯片城！这里的图纸、面积和流程是教学模型，我们一起读懂: Bring your Tcl skills to Chip City! The blueprints, areas and flows are teaching models. Let us read the reports together.
